items.title: Is MAGA cracking up, or having a nervous breakdown? Who gives a shit, let’s just enjoy their bitter tears
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
MAGA-on-MAGA violence — it’s what’s for breakfast.

In the wake of the disastrous midterms, the worst fucking people in the world all have their long knives out right now — and these magnificent morons are getting stabby on the best possible targets: each other.

So let’s all microwave some popcorn, settle in, and enjoy the carnage.

Nosferatu McGoebbels hates the shit out of Marky Two-Names

The undead White House Chief of Staff is very very mad at the failed plumber’s assistant right now.

It’s all about .

MULLIN ON OUTAGES: “I talked to one guy in the tech industry, he asked not to mention his name, it’s not Elon. I asked, what could be causing these outages? He said I believe it's SI, because these programs aren’t designed to work as fast as SI is. So when they put in a program that’s able to write codes and it goes in and self-fixes, as it starts to self-fix itself it like a change order on a house. That kind of makes sense to me.”

For all we know, Marky just committed an honesty. is a vastly more logical explanation of what could bring down an entire system, than the ‘it was this one ferkaktah router’ line the rest of the administration has been spouting.

Nonetheless, when Nosferatu got wind of what Marky’d said on Hannity, he got so upset that he choked on the bat he’d been eating.

Oh, no — anything but that! The horror.

Brian Kilmeade hates the shit out of Couckfuck McGee

Fox’s Brian Kilmeade goes scorched earth on JD Vance: “He never should have been vice president.”

Wow, what did Couchfuck say to set off Kilmeade? It must have been a doozy, right?

“But my prediction, Laura, is that whatever the president ultimately decides to do, there are going to be people who demand more, who want the war to go on indefinitely,” Vance said.

The vice president insisted there was “no daylight” between himself and Trump on the issue, adding that the president “is not going to let this become a forever war.”

Couchfuck didn’t accuse of wanting the war to go on. But there’s built-up resentment here, because Vance has decided that his path to the Republican presidential nomination in 2028 is to be the ‘I would have never gone into Iran’ candidate. He’d been making noises to that effect recently — and that shit absolutely will not fly with the ‘Dear Leader is never wrong’ crowd.

So it doesn’t matter how JD’s now fine-tuning his remarks. The crime has already been committed. So of course Kilmeade was going to go ballistic.

And also of course, MAGA is crashing out right now. They’re losing their minds over the midterms. They don’t want . So you can go fuck yourself, Mister Couchfuck McGee, if that even is your real name. Fuck straight off with your stupid

Hey, guess what I have in my pocket for Brian Kilmeade — and Nosferatu McGoebbels as well, and all these Donnyverse dumbfucks who are so very very sad-mad right now.

It’s the world’s tiniest violin!

Of course, Couchfuck has been sniffing glue if he imagines he has path to the presidency in 2028, but that’s an entire different discussion for another day.

The entire MAGAverse hates the shit out of John Thune

JOHN THUNE JUST NOW: “Any exit poll that you look at would tell you it was about the war, it was about the economy, it was about inflation, it was about gas prices...none of which any of our candidates had much control over.”

We lost nine Senate seats because @LeaderJohnThune is retarded.

Have you noticed a pattern here? The entire MAGAverse can’t handle hearing the truth right now. Not from Marky Two-Names, not from Couchfuck McGee, and certainly some piece of shit senator, droning on about and and . They just want to rage and vent — oh, and they want a scapegoat. Check that, they don’t just want a scapegoat. They

What a load of crap. The outcome of the midterms were because of Everyone being sick of @LeaderJohnThune sitting on HUNDREDS of bills the House already passed, but HE refused to allow the senate to vote on.

Remember, Dear Leader can never fail. He can only And this time, he’s being failed by John Thune, because .

Hey, all you MAGAverse whiners taking it out on John Thune — I have something here for you, too.

Eat binky, you crybaby losers. Sucks to be you.

Dinesh D’Ipshit and the Nazi Incel hate the shit out of each other.

Who even cares? Lets just enjoy these two tiresome shitwits wailing on each other.

Now let’s have our Hero of the Day — Democratic Senator Richard Blumenthal.

All this week, the good Senator has been making fools of Donny’s nominees, by asking them simple questions. Questions like ‘who won the 2020 election?’ and ‘was there an attack on the Capitol on January 6th?’ Of course, none of these nominees can give an honest answer, for fear of angering the Audience of One, watching back in the Oval Bordello.

Senator Blumenthal: “Mr. LoSapio, who won the popular vote in 2020, in the presidential election?”

Michael LoSapio: “I’m— I’m not going to answer the question about an election six years ago. What I’m here to answer—”

Blumenthal: “You’re in charge of election security, correct?”

LoSapio:

Blumenthal: “You’re supposed to look at the facts. And you’re supposed to tell us the facts.”

Blumenthal: “I’m asking you a factual question.”

LoSapio: “I’m— my only involvement in the 2020 election was voting for the president of the United States.”

Blumenthal: “You’re ducking the question, in a way that betrays your lack of independence and objectivity. Those qualities are essential to the role that you are going to play. Are you going to answer the question or not?”

LoSapio:

Blumenthal: “You are disqualified from the position that you have been nominated to fill.”

Holy shit. Imagine being this proud of being this neutered, in fealty to Dear Leader.

Mr. LoSapio, as a consolation prize, would you like a tiny violin, or a binky? Oh, you won’t answer? Fine, I’ll chose for you. Here you go.

Well, it’s Friday — and we made it through another week in one piece. Let’s reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia and get out of here.

Here’s Ms Spouse doing a little gardening on May 26, 2016.

And here she is on the patio, waiting for her devoted husband to finish making Sunday brunch, on September 30, 2018.

And here she is, June 1, 2011.

Have a great Friday, everyone.

items.title: Shh! Don’t wake Preznit Fuckwit — international geopolitics makes him sleepy
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
That’s right, the narcoleptic old fart factory’s brain went again yesterday, right in the middle of an APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting in China.

But before we get to that —

This is just so fucking bizarre. Are we all on crazy pills right now?

How creepy is this? Why is she there? She has no legitimate function in that room. How does this keep happening, in meeting after meeting? Does she simply invite herself along, and no one says ?

Imagine you’re a world leader, sitting across the table from all that. How could you even concentrate, with that spectacle going on? What do you say to your spouse when you get home? ‘You will never fucking believe what happened today. The silly dipshit brought a date

You know what? Let’s skip over the question of why is Natty there, because here’s a better question: Why is there?

What value does presence add? All he does is ramble incoherently about his own imaginary accomplishments, and piss and moan if he doesn’t get a toy.

“There’s never been a time like this. But of course it was— right here— in this [unintelligible] palace that President— Quezon bestowed General Douglas MacArthur with a gold— baton, and the rank of Field Marshall in the Philippine Army. I’d like to have you do that for me, if you don’t mind. I’d love that. I mean, why the hell shouldn’t I get that?”

Yeah, come on, President Marcos, get with the program. Don’t you know by now that Donny always gets a participation trophy, no matter where he goes? FIFA gave him one. So did NASA. So give the whiny little piss-baby his fucking gold baton before he falls to pieces, like a child in a supermarket who can’t have candy.

Seriously, what’s the point of even having Donny there at your meeting? My advice to every international organization — APEC, the Quad, NATO, the G7, the United Nations, the OAS, — is this: the next time you hold a wingding, don’t bother inviting Donny. I promise that you won’t even notice his absence, except for maybe air quality having been improved by the lack of narcoleptic farts.

After Dear Leader shit the bed in the Philippines, it was on to China, where Donny was serenely unaware that he was the mark.

“They’re treating me extremely well for China, and I have a lot of respect and a good relationship with President Xi ... nobody is gonna play games with us.”

Oh my god, this gullible goofus has no idea he was being set up to be swindled. He’s so easily manipulated that it isn’t even funny. the Chinese are treating him ‘extremely well’ — they’re buttering him up so they can pick his pockets.

Donny is like the chump at the blackjack table in a Las Vegas casino. He’s losing his shirt, but all he can do is marvel over how they keep giving him free drinks.

Donny:

Fox bobblehead: “Are you going to tell them to stop buying Iranian oil?”

Donny: “You know, when they say that China is working with— with uh, Iran, or Russia’s working with Iran, no, no. What, they’re giving some information? We have all the information that they give. We know exactly what they’re giving. It’s peanuts.”

Hang on, did Dear Leader just hand-wave away China and Russia feeding intel to Iran, because ? He did, didn’t he. What in the actual fuck?

Look, it’s not just that’s being provided to Iran. China is Iran’s largest buyer of crude oil. Russia is helping Iran re-arm itself. Do you imagine that Donny doesn’t know that, or just doesn’t care, because — as he so idiotically puts it — I can’t decide which scenario is worse. What a great idea it was, to let a greedy and easily-flattered shit-for-brains be president.

Tell me, is allowing our adversaries to get away with aiding a country we’re at war with, because you expect you’ll personally benefit from doing so — would that be a

I’m hopeful that we’ll find out at Donny’s third impeachment trial, next year.

Now I can hear you out there, going ‘but Uncle Jeff, what about the Nodfather? You promised at the top of this post that Donny would be sleeping.’

Yes, I know I did, but we had to get through the boring-but-more-important stuff first. Don’t make me come over there and explain how clickbait works.

Holy fuck, Dear Leader is out like a light. He doesn’t move a millimeter during the entire clip. The only way to tell that you’re not looking at a still photograph is that you can see Soybean Scott Bessent’s smug haughty head moving in the background, behind Donny.

Who thought it would be a good idea to let a doddering demento attend four meetings across two countries in one day?

I have an idea. Can we get that Arlington Guard back in here, to stand behind Donny and scream ‘ALL PRESIDENTS WILL MAINTAIN AN ATMOSPHERE OF NOT FALLING THE FUCK ASLEEP AND EMBARRASSING YOUR ENTIRE COUNTRY’?

Because that would fucking rule.

And now, on to our Daily Claudia.

Here are two photos taken in Plymouth, MA, back in the early 1990s, by Daughter Katie. This first one is from before she was old enough to have figured out that whole ‘don’t crop people’s heads off’ thing.

And this second one, thankfully, is from after.

Have a great Thursday, everyone.

Oh wait — one final thing before I let you go.

I have no idea what this unsubscriber means by ‘too much porn type stuff.’ Is it the cussing? Folks, I hope you’re all reading these posts and discovering that I have a sweary fucking mouth you plunk down your hard-earned cash on a paid subscription.

Oh, and don’t be fooled by all the free drinks at the blackjack table.

Okay, you can all fucking well have a great fucking Thursday.

items.title: What the fuck is on Dear Leader’s head?
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Seriously, what in the actual fuck?

The Donny we all saw heading for Bribe Force One yesterday morning was the one we’re all familiar with: the belligerent racist moron with the rat’s nest of yellow piss-mop hair atop his big, dumb pumpkin head.

Sure, because nothing says ‘I’m a dignified world leader’ more than wrapping one’s misshapen body in a cheap misshapen suit, gazing at the world through dull, vacant eyes, standing like a toddler who just planted a fresh load into its pull-ups, and spastically waving two child-size flags held in two child-sized fists.

And, of course, the shit-emoji hair.

Who thought this was a good idea? Let me guess. It was the bunny-boiling diaper nurse. Looking up from the notebook where she’d devoted the last two hours to scrawling over and over and over, she said, ‘Sir! Sir! I know how we can make you even more handsome! Sir!’, and pulled a tube of Grecian Formula out of her diaper bag.

It happened because there are no adults left in the room. With the last responsible human being, Susie Wiles, banished to that big farm upstate where she now has lots of room to run around, it’s just Donny, the diaper nurse and and Acting President Nosferatu McGoebbels — and he could give a fuck what Donny and Natty get up to, as long as they leave him alone to actually run the country.

So that’s why, while the entire world goes to shit all around us, and, one by one, the online services we’ve come to depend on go , the topic of the day aboard Bribe Force One was Natty going, ‘you know what be cool? Let’s do you up like a poopsicle.’

“It’s life. When you’re big and powerful and have all the money, things like that happen — it’s fine.”

I’m sorry, but what the fuck kind of answer is ? No, it’s not fine. It’s only if you’re a privileged moron who lives in a pampered bubble, has all his needs taken care of for him, and jets around in a vulgar flying bordello that some emirs bribed him with.

Let’s do this. Let’s imagine it’s 2023, and Joe Biden is president. Let’s say all the planes are grounded, you can’t get into your email, and your online banking app won’t work. Now let’s imagine that Biden, brown crap smeared all over his head, shows up goes,

Do you think the worthless scribblers of the corporate-controlled press would have accepted that answer, and just gone ‘well I guess it’s fine, if Joe says so’?

Absolutely not. They would have roasted Biden alive.

Now imagine that Biden had pulled out a couple of flags and started waving them around like a meth-tweaked mental patient.

Jake Tapper would have personally taken it upon himself to burn the White House to the ground.

Meanwhile, back on Planet Earth, the Senate was holding a confirmation hearing for Acting Navy Secretary, Hung Cao. But let me back up a bit, and fill you in on how Hung Cao came to be our acting head of the Navy.

“It’s really an honor to be with you,” Trump said with Cao to his right. “Thank you. And we’re gonna be with this man. This is a great gentleman. I love his name — Hung Cao. I love that name. And that name alone should get you elected, right?”

Spoiler alert: Hung Cao’s name get him elected in 2024, because Hung Cao is a fucking crackpot who ran for Senate because, quite frankly,

“There’s a place in Monterey, California called Lovers Point. The original name was Lovers of Christ Point. But now they took out the Christ, it’s become Lovers Point — really, Monterey is a really dark place now, a lot of witchcraft and the wiccan community has really taken over there, and we can’t let that happen in Virginia.”

Hung Cao seems sane, doesn’t he?

And because Donny has a knack for always being able to find the worst person possible for each job, he plucked Wytchfinder Cao from the shitpile of failure and made him his Undersecretary of the Navy.

For once in his entire stupid life, Donny didn’t hire a flunkie because he looked good on Fox News. No, this time he picked the dude whose name makes him think of a .

And now, Cao — the scourge of witches from Monterey to Virginia — is our Acting Secretary of the Navy.

Mark Kelly: “So are you saying the reports of sailors losing 45 pounds are not true?”

Hung Cao: “It’s just not what they want. It’s like my kids opening up the refrigerator door and saying, ‘there’s nothing to eat here.’”

Kelly: “Somebody doesn’t lose 45 pounds just because they don’t like the options. I don’t think that’s a fair assessment.”

Are you fucking kidding me? What kind of answer is, ‘yeah, these sailors are just picky eaters.’

In any fair world, Cao would have immediately been transported to a ship in the middle of the ocean and been forced to eat rotting food for eight months. And then if he said anything about it, we could just go ‘shut the fuck up and stop being a prima donna.’

It’s stunning how not one of these Donnyverse sewer clowns can ever just simply say ‘yeah, we fucked up. We’ll do better next time,’

I guess he realized he .

Peltola won with 50.1% of the vote. That’s more than both Dan Sullivans combined, so Preznit Fuckwit and Attorney General Muggsy and all the whiners in the MAGAsphere can sit on it and twirl.

Now let’s have us our Daily Claudia.

Today’s curation comes courtesy of the Google Photos app, which, for some reason, all on its own and without my prompting, took it upon itself to send me a link to a collection it created and called ‘Claudia eads.’ Here’s some of what it picked.

In the living room on February 14, 2016.

On the patio on August 30, 2016.

In the living room on January 1, 2017.

In the back yard on May 7, 2020.

And at Blu Pointe in Newburgh, on January 30, 2025.

Have a great Wednesday, everyone. I could get used to having Google’s janky curation robot do my work for me. Hey bro, you want to write tomorrow’s post?

items.title: Racist with shitty hair does a racism, to the surprise of nobody
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Hey, let’s check in with that racist slumlord from Queens, New York. You know who I mean. The one who, in 1973, along with his tyrant Klansman father, got fined by the federal government for refusing to rent any of their shitty apartments to black people.

What ever happened to that guy?

NBC News White House correspondent Yamiche Alcindor: “What do you say to critics who say you were too focused on DC construction projects while our airline systems were crumbling, given the fact that Republicans have been in control?”

Racist slumlord from Queens: “Well, if you take a look at the White House, it’s flawless. If you— listen to me, I know you don’t see dirt, but if you take a look at the White House, you never notice broken windows, obviously, from where you come.”

‘From where you come’? What the fuck? Yamiche Alcindor was born and raised in Miami. I guess when the racist slumlord from Queens sees someone with black skin, he just presumes they’re from one of what he so charmingly calls the ‘shithole’ countries.

Okay, I have an idea. Hear me out. You know that Arlington Guard who became a national hero last week for screaming ‘ALL VISITORS WILL MAINTAIN AN ATMOSPHERE OF SILENCE AND PAY RESPECT!’ at Piss-Drunk Pete and his giggling entourage?

You know you I’m talking about. This dude.

Can we get that Guard to stand right behind Donny and scream something like ‘ALL PRESIDENTS WILL STOP BEING A RACIST FUCKING MORON!” every time he opens his damn fool mouth?

So this is now a thing, with Donny? His dementia has increased to the point where all filters have gone , and he’ll just be as racist as he wants to be? Remember, it was just last week that he spewed pretty much the same bigoted crap about Obama, during one of his Oval Bordello whine sessions.

“When you look at that White House, you know, I hear Obama, but he— Obama doesn’t know about dirt and filth. And he doesn’t know about cracked stones. And he doesn’t know about broken windows. He’s probably fine with them. But I’m not. I’m not fine with them.”

So, inside the putrefying pudding-brain of the racist slumlord from Queens, black people have some kind of endemic filth-blindness. What a completely fucked-up thing to believe.

You absolutely know who taught Donny to be this racist, don’t you? Of course you do. It was Donny’s own father — the one who got arrested at a Klan rally in 1927. You just know that at some point, Old Fred sat his son down and said, ‘now Donny, we don’t rent to black people. They’re animals. They don’t see dirt. They don’t care about broken windows.’

Except the word he used probably didn’t start with B.

This is what we’re dealing with. A president who imagines he’s superior to others, simply because of the color of his skin. And he’s aided and abetted by an undead Chief of Staff and a piss-drunk Secretary of Death who believe the same fucked-up thing.

The racist slumlord from Queens has a lot of goddamned gall, looking down on Obama as an inferior. Have you ever seen those side-by-side photos of Donny and Obama with the Queen?

Obama looks like an elegant world leader. Donny looks like the hungover waiter at a cut-rate strip-mall spaghetti restaurant.

Oh, can we get that hero Guard back in here for a minute?

Reporter: “Any update on what happened last Friday with the FAA and the airspace?”

Donny: “I hate to blame anybody, but the Biden administration hooked up a lot of copper into glass, and copper, if you know anything about electrical engineering, you cannot hook up copper into glass.”

Oh dear sweet Confucius on a crab cake, he’s such a fucking idiot.

If I had to guess, I’d say that someone tried to explain to Sundowning Grandpa Befuddlepants about converting copper wires to fiber optic cable — and the moron understood absolutely zero of what he was told. Only now, the racist slumlord imagines that he knows more about electrical engineering than all the electrical engineers — even the big, strong teary-eyed ones, like few thought possible. Listen to him blither about ‘copper into glass.’ He has no idea what he’s talking about, yet he’s supremely convinced of his own genius.

Oh, to have the serene self-confidence of the mediocre white man. Donny is what would happen if Dunning and Kruger had a baby, and then repeatedly dropped it on its head.

And guess what: you absolutely ‘hook up copper into glass.’

In the interest of Responsible Journalism and Everything™, I asked Google’s janky, six-fingered plagiarism robot exactly that, and here’s what it told me.

You can interface copper wiring with fiber-optic (glass) cabling. This is a standard practice in modern data and telecommunication networks. [1, 2]

  • Devices like , transceivers (such as SFP modules), or act as the bridge, translating electrical—

Okay, you can shut the fuck up now, plagiarism robot. Let me stop you right there. We don’t need to know it works, just that it work.

My god, how the plagiarism bot will natter on, if you let it.

Reporter: “What responsibility do you take for the ground stop on Friday given that you're the president?”

Donny: “I don’t take any responsibility.”

Donny not taking responsibility? Gee, where have I heard this before?

Of course Donny won’t take responsibility. That’s how chickenshit cowards roll, even though this whole mess is his fault. He’s the one who fired the team Biden had assembled to oversee the air traffic control upgrade. He’s the one who, on the first day of his second term, signed an executive order freezing the funds that had been allocated for the upgrade. He’s the only who let a reality-show wash-out be Transportation Secretary, and put a failed plumber’s assistant in charge of Homeland Security. He’s the only who didn’t raise a finger to stop the Space Nazi’s merry band of unfuckable DOGE incels from firing four hundred experts at the FAA.

The racist slumlord from Queens , whether he wants to admit it or not.

Oh, can we hear from our hero Guard one final time?

‘ALL PRESIDENTS WILL STOP COMBING THEIR FUCKED-UP RAT’S NEST OF COTTON-CANDY BULLSHIT HAIR WITH AN EGG-BEATER!”

Yeeesh. What the fuck is going on up there? I’ll bet the racist slumlord from Queens doesn’t take responsibility for the debacle on top of his big, dumb pumpkin head, either.

Everything right now, and is going to continue to until at least January 3rd of next year, but at least we can enjoy these Rutgers students screaming ‘get the fuck out of here’ at the Itsy-Bitsy Nazi, Obergruppenführer Greg Bovino, until he flees the Rutgers Republicans event where he’d been trying to speak.

Now let’s have us our Daily Claudia.

Oh hey, I found some more wedding photos that I’d forgotten existed, while sorting though some of Ms Spouse’s files yesterday.

You’ve seen this one before.

But I’ve never posted these two, from September 4, 1984.

Have a great Tuesday, everyone.

items.title: Dear Leader’s not dead yet. In fact, he’s feeling much better.
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Loyal and patriotic citizens, once again we must ask you to please stand by for a message of the utmost importance from the President of the United States, Supreme Ruler of the Western Hemisphere, Lord-Emperor of the Sky Above and All the Planets, Conqueror Of Every War, God’s Own Avatar on Earth, Grand Re-namer of Water, Master Builder of Vulgar Dance Halls and the Pants-Shittingest Moron to Ever Crap Himself In the Oval Bordello.

“I am in the White House having meetings on many subjects. Very exciting times for the USA. Great things are happening - We are the “hottest” Country anywhere in the World! President DJT”

Oh my god. This fragile, easily-triggered bottomless well of dipshit need took the bait. He couldn’t leave it alone. He heard all the chatter on the socials about ‘where’s Donny? We haven’t seen him for days. Is he dead?’

And so Preznit Fuckwit just couldn’t help himself. He just had to fart out some patently false, ‘I’m having many meetings on many subjects. You don’t know the people I’m meeting with. They go to a different school, in Canada.’

Does Donny seriously have no idea what a fool he’s making of himself? Everyone knows he’s not having ‘many meetings on many subjects.’ He’s been on some IV drip, or playing patty-cake with Natty while watching himself on TV.

‘I’m not dead yet. In fact. I’m feeling much better. I think I’ll go for a walk.’

You’re not fooling anyone.

He’s such an embarrassment. MAGA, how the fuck are you not ashamed to have hitched your wagon to this unserious goofball?

Anyway, we’re going to get plenty of proof of life from Donny this week. Way too much proof of life

Today, Donny heads to the Philippines, where tomorrow he’s taking part in a meeting of ‘the Quad’ — the leaders of US, Japan, Australia and India. So you know what that means: breathless coverage of Donny dementedly weaving across tarmacs, waving to imaginary crowds, and falling asleep in his chair while crop-dusting the President of Japan.

If we’re really lucky, we’ll get to watch Dear Leader wander past the open door of his limo, as his security detail tries desperately — and without success — to lure him back to reality.

Who thought this was a good idea?

Oh sure, let’s take an 80-year-old demento in cognitive collapse, fly him halfway across the world, so he gets good and disoriented, and sit him down with two homies who are both smarter and craftier than he is. What could possibly go wrong?

If we’re lucky, all that will happen is that our narcoleptic fart-factory president will immediately pass out, leaving Xi and Putin to marinate in the pungent aroma of Donny’s ass music.

Worst case, Preznit Fuckwit gives away the store, gets taken to the cleaners, and sells out our allies.

If Donny’s minders and flunkies gave a shit about the United States, or our allies, or anyone at all but their own corrupt, greedy selves, they would not be allowing this meeting between Donny and his despot besties to take place.

Donny should be confined to the White House, when he can canoodle to his heart’s content with the diaper nurse, while pretending to have

If Congress approves the desperately needed money for Air Traffic Control, we can get it built quickly and efficiently. It will be the BEST SYSTEM anywhere in the World. Much of our current air control system is 50 years old - RIDICULOUS! We have already started the work, but it should be done all at once, not in drips and drabs. Congress must approve. The Biden Administration set it back years! President DJT

Donny’s trying to pin this all on Joe Biden, because . That’s his signature move whenever shit goes sideways. Sleepy Joe Biden, blah blah blah. Fuck straight off with this fever-swamp fairy tale, Donny.

NEWS: Trump Was Warned About Air Traffic Control Risks

A group of aviation experts warned in 2023 that rushing the modernization of air traffic control systems was risky. In 2024, the Biden Administration asked the same group to look at air traffic control safety issues.

Trump disbanded the group in 2025.

Got that? Joe Biden was advised that our nation’s air traffic control system was in serious need of upgrading, and he did what any responsible leader would do — he set forth to make it happen.

But then Donny slithered his slimy way back into office, immediately decided we didn’t need that shit, and disbanded Biden’s air traffic task force.

If any of that sounds familiar, it should, because back in 2016, Obama left Donny with a detailed, 69-page plan about what do to if we ever had a pandemic — and Donny was all ‘why the fuck would I want this?’

Tell me, how did the lack of a plan work out for us, when covid took everyone by surprise? Instead of an actual expertise, we had a moron telling us to gargle horse paste and inject bleach.

In September, the Government Accountability Office (GAO) warned that the Trump Administration’s modernization approach prioritized “speed at the risk of cost uncertainty and potential disruptions.”

Now we’re seeing why those warnings mattered. The rush to replace the system before Trump leaves office is causing chaos and putting lives at risk.

Modernizing our aging air traffic control system is essential. But you can’t just rip out old technology, install new equipment, and hope for the best.

Do you remember what Sean Duffy spent his summer doing? Spoiler alert: he wasn’t working on an air traffic control plan. If you recall, he spent seven months filming a reality show that no one ended up watching.

Good use of everyone’s time, am I right? Maybe we should all be gargling horse paste right now. Maybe that’ll keep the planes in the air.

Could guzzling goo be any worse than Duffy’s actual plan, which involves giving a no-bid contract to a crony, and then hastily installing whatever janky crap they shit out, without first properly testing it?

Here’s a fun fact: transportation secretaries can be impeached, you know.

Congress needs to investigate what went wrong, and determine what safeguards are needed to prevent more damage from being done.

January 3rd. It’s just 48 days from today. Let’s hope these dumbfucks don’t break everything all to hell before then.

I know, this sounds like the winner of a make-up-the-dumbest-sounding-scandal-you-can

Foundation Future Industries, a maker of military humanoid robots advised and backed by Eric Trump, failed to pay employees last month as its cash reserves dwindled, according to people with direct knowledge of the matter.

Workers have yet to receive paychecks after San Francisco-based Foundation missed payroll on Oct. 30, said the people, who asked for anonymity to speak candidly about a private company.

The situation has particularly angered some inside the startup because its CEO and co-founder, Sankaet Pathak, borrowed $4.6 million from the company last year to buy a luxury home, money that could have been used to pay workers, the people said.

How is it that everything that Donny or one of his felonious failsons gets their fingers on, ends up being tainted by scandal? You would imagine that every now and then, they’d fall ass-backwards into doing something honest, just by accident — but no. Everything — no matter what it is — ended up being some kind of fly-by-night grift.

Fucking hell, now it’s .

You can’t make this shit up, because who would believe it?

Now let’s have us our Daily Claudia.

Here are two shots of Ms Spouse I found while scrolling through her Facebook page. This one’s from the 1980s, at her bff Mandi’s apartment.

This next one’s from the 2000s. I don’t recognize the location, and Ms Spouse was terrible at captioning the stuff she put up on Facebook.

Have a great Monday, everyone.

items.title: It fucking sucks when your government lies to you all the time
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Hey, folks? I hope you’re sitting down right now, because it seems like the administration that lied about Iranian nukes, and lied about Venezuelan fishermen, and lied about our borders, and lied about our economy, and lied about tariffs, and lied about our elections, and lied about Preznit Fuckwit’s putrefying brain, rotting hands and bloated cankles, just might be lying to us again.

On Friday afternoon, two super-fun things happened, right in a row.

First, our nation’s air-traffic control system suddenly went , grounding every single plane in our airspace, and stranding one and a half million travelers.

The second thing that happened was that two complete fucking morons held a press conference, in which they attempted to explain what happened.

Did these nitwits — the reality-show never-was Sean Duffy, and the plumber’s assistant with anger management issues, Markwayne Mullin — have any idea what they were talking about?

I have no clue. All I know is that we all picked the wrong week to stop sniffing glue.

Maybe Duffy’s story was true — There’s no way of knowing for sure. My point is, you can’t trust the Donnyverse to ever give you the straight dope on . And that shit is unsustainable.

Chaos, fear and mistrust is no way to run a government.

All I know is that the air traffic controllers themselves seem to think Duffy is lying. Washington Examiner homeland security reporter Anna Giaritelli actually committed a journalism, and talked to sixty of them — and they’re all calling bullshit.

I’ve spoken with 60 air traffic controllers tonight about what Sean Duffy said at the White House today. None of them are buying what he said because they said these types of switches that the FAA is doing, they don’t happen during the day, they don’t happen during busy times like a Friday afternoon. They’re doing these midweek, middle of the night when there is no air traffic going on. The controllers were saying, “We don’t buy that this is actually what’s happening, the reason that Sean Duffy is saying this has happened.”

Then there’s the issue of timing. The outage came just a couple of days after massive, data-hungry AI servers had been plugged into the air traffic system.

Are we being lied to about that?

The press conference today was one of the most blatant examples of political corruption as I’ve ever seen. They spent 30 minutes not answering WHAT caused the issue, avoiding the truth that it was their own AI rollout which caused the “data spike.”

That sounds plausible, doesn’t it? Is is true? Once again, who even knows?

AI servers suck down data like there’s no tomorrow. One could easily overload a network that wasn’t built to accommodate it.

My point remains: it shouldn’t be up to We the People to be citizen fact-checkers. We should have a government we can trust to at least give us something that

Q: You were trying to make upgrades at 3 o’clock on Friday afternoon. Why? Why not do it at say midnight on Saturday when there are fewer planes lined up to take off?

DUFFY: There will be a reevaluation of when we do this work

‘There will be a reevaluation?’ What kind of non-answer answer is that?

FAA union president says DOGE fired essential employees without assessment

Dave Spero, the president of a union representing employees of the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), said at a Tuesday hearing that the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) fired essential employees without accounting for the impact their departure would have on the agency’s functions.

Is there even anyone left at the FAA who knows enough to keep Duffy from doing stupid shit on a Friday afternoon?

Oh, sure. Who among us hasn’t looked at a leaky faucet in our kitchen sink and gone, ‘oh yeah, that’s gonna be fifty billion.’

Mike Johnson: ‘We don’t really need any investigation’ into FAA ground stop

House Speaker Mike Johnson (R-La.) said there is no need for an investigation into the ground stop issued by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) on Friday, instead highlighting the need for “investment.”

I fucking swear, Holy Mike Johnson is useless. He’s absolutely useless. He is, he’s as useless as a marzipan dildo.

Thank god Holy Mike has only seven weeks left on the job. Maybe once the adults take over, we can finally get some straight answers.

“It’s been a somewhat bizarre and certainly uncharacteristic silence from the president, yesterday and today, on all of this, he has not spoken out publicly, yesterday or today. He has not posted anything on Truth Social, yesterday or today, about the entire situation. We are told by a White House official that the president is receiving constant updates about the air traffic situation in the United States, but he certainly has not come out and said anything or posted anything on it. We’re not expected to hear from the president this evening.”

Oh great, something else for the White House to lie to us about.

Like clockwork, Donny goes MIA, and will probably finally make an appearance around Tuesday or Wednesday, with a fresh round of hideous bruises all over his hands. No doubt he’ll regale us with more stories about how the doctors were amazed at how he once again pointed to the drawing of the camel, like few thought possible.

Will we ever get the truth about what’s going on with Dear Leader’s health? Of course we won’t. We’re being lied to be professional lying liars who lie.

(Update, 9:30am Sunday morning. Donny — or, just as likely, the diaper nurse posing in his name — finally said something about the air traffic debacle. Spoiler alert: he blamed it on Joe Biden, because of course he did.)

This insistence that he’s ‘in the White House having many meetings on many subjects’ is all the proof you need that right now, Donny is hooked up to a dozen machines and IV drips, failing to point to the camel.)

Look, governments lie all the time. Dear Leader didn’t invent this shit. We got lied into Vietnam. We got lied into Iraq.

But the Donnyverse has taken the lying dial and twisted it so far past eleven that the fucking thing has snapped off in their hands. These shitweasels lie about everything — even shit they don’t need to lie about. They do it just for fun. And We the People are left unable to be sure of what’s real and what isn’t.

Let me repeat myself one last time: Chaos, fear and mistrust is no way to run a government. None of this shit is sustainable.

It’s long past time for a reckoning.

January 3rd can’t come soon enough.

That’s enough rage for one day, isn’t it? Let’s cleanse the palate with some Daily Claudia.

These three selfies were taken at 1:45 in the morning on January 1, 2019, during a New Year’s Eve party at our friends Nicole and Altin’s house.

Have a great Sunday, everyone.

items.title: This Week in Stupid: November 14 edition
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
As another stupid week comes to a close here in America, let’s look back at the dumbest fucking shit that happened.

“A smart man washes his hands after he urinates. A wise man doesn’t urinate on his hands.”

Um, Senator Kennedy? I have a question.

I really wish more of his colleagues had gone to Oxford with him, because I’m pretty sure the entire MAGAverse has been pissing on its own hands for years.

Tuesday: a septum is a terrible thing to waste

“…was sentenced at Southwork Crown Court to ten years and six months in prison. One rape conviction. Three sexual assault convictions. He was convicted by the way, with no forensic evidence. No DNA. No police report from the time. Now, decades old, from allegations back from 1999.”

Now there’s a good look. Defending the convicted rapist Russell Brand while seemingly having half the gross national product of Bolivia up one’s nostrils.

Holy shit, can Don Jr. even feel his face right now? It doesn’t look like it.

Do you know why Hunter Biden was able to clean himself up? Because he wanted to, and because he had a loving family willing to get him the help he needed.

Cokey’s family is apparently too busy pissing on their own hands to help him deal with his shit.

Wednesday: a sense of decency is a terrible thing to waste

We can’t see Rick Santorum’s hands in the clip below, but I’ll wager good money that he was pissing all over them while recording it.

“Face it, these are temporal issues. Yes, they matter. Of course they matter. You’re upset because prices are high. And I don’t think the president has done a particularly good job of explain why the war in Iran was so essential to fight radical Islam. But the reality is, you know, everybody has to look at what the bigger issues are in the country. And I understand paying a dollar more our two or three dollars more for diesel fuel has an impact on your family. But you have a responsibility to look beyond just comply what affects your pocketbook. And there may be a reason that you have to suffer financially for a higher good.”

Can these idiots get any more tone-deaf?

This is why your party got slaughtered at the polls, Rick. Voters won’t want to be lectured on how it’s their patriotic duty to shut the fuck up about gas prices.

You know what? I hope the GOP keeps right on repeating this noxious nonsense, all the way to the 2028 elections. I hope they continue to be as repellent as possible. Maybe we can end up with zero elected Republicans. You may say I’m a dreamer, but I’m not the only one.

Hey, did Rick Santorum and that dog he was seeing ever get married? I hope they’re very happy together.

No, seriously, did he? For some reason, Senator Mushmouth really wants to know.

Thursday: a mind is a terrible thing to have never had in the first place

“Unfortunately, we were all wrong, races can be baught.”

Oh my god, can I just say that I AM GOING TO MISS THIS WOMAN. She has been a boon to This Week In Stupid. She’s a one-woman perpetual motion dumbfuck-factory. By voting her out of office and removing her from the public eye, the people of Colorado’s fourth district have really made my job that much harder.

And, I hope that wherever Lauren Boebert ends up next, she keeps washing her hands. For many reasons.

Friday: the further adventures of Some Fucking Idiot™

On Friday, some fucking idiot was missing in action. He had no public appearances, and —shockingly! — only posted three times to his crappy app. But not to worry, his ace team of cabinet-level hand-pissers were way too happy to step into the breach.

You’ll never fucking guess what happened on Friday.

Oh, and Marky Two-Names, the former failed plumber’s assistant now ostensibly in charge of homeland security was on the case, too. His main concern was that everybody called the plagiarism robot by its proper name.

So, what was the fucking idiot doing while all this was going on? Did he go on TV to reassure a nervous nation? Did he say anything at all?

All this, while every plane in the nation was stuck on the ground, leaving ONE AND A HALF MILLION air travelers stranded.

And because the fucking idiot was missing in action, holed up god knows where in the White House with his beloved Diaper Nurse, not one reporter had the opportunity to stand up and ask, ‘what the fuck is wrong with you?’

How fucking idiotic is that?

And now, let’s put a close to This Week in Stupid and reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia.

This photo has ‘June 15, 1996’ written on the back of it. I have no idea where it was taken.

Here we are at some family event in the 1990s. that’s my uncle Alan and aunt Ellen, and there’s Katie in the background, seated at a table. Ms Spouse sure had style, didn’t she?

Have a non-stupid Saturday, everyone.

items.title: Let’s all point and laugh at the panicking imbecile in the Oval Bordello
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Pour one out for Preznit Fuckwit. He’s going through some things right now.

No, strike that — pour them out for Preznit Fuckwit. He’s going through right now. Donny knows that come January, once the Democratic majorities are sworn in, his life is going to — and he’s having a rather hard time coping.

The rabid family of coked-up raccoons that live inside Dear Leader’s fat, waterlogged skull were seriously working overtime yesterday morning, chewing through the wires. Donny was wide awake and panic-posting around 5am, shitting out increasingly-deranged lunacy onto his crappy app. Every grudge and grievance got a good airing out.

The Democrat Party, lead by one of the most Corrupt and anti-American groups of political leaders and hacks in the history of our Country, and even the World, is doing everything in their power to get away from MASSIVE BLUE STATE CORRUPTION by saying, over and over again, that the Trump Administration is corrupt. It is a sound bite that they viciously use, over and over again, in order to nullify the TREMENDOUS & UNPRECEDENTED theft that has taken place in our Blue States - Minnesota, California, and others, all over the U.S.A. I, perhaps foolishly because the Fake News refuses to write about it, including in my First Term, don’t even take a Salary, worth Millions of Dollars. I am the only President to have done so! In any event, THE DEMOCRATS ARE CORRUPT AND EVIL, and I am the exact opposite! Fight hard, Republicans, or you won’t have a Country left! President DONALD J. TRUMP

Corrupty McCorruptionface says what?

Next year, Democrats are going to have a field day, looking into Dear Leader’s malfeasance. Just off the top of my head, there’s the selling of pardons, the insider trading, the crypto scams, the market manipulation, and the doling out of massive defense contracts to his felonious failsons.

And the only thing Donny can say in his own defense is ‘I know you are, but what am I?’

Q: Trump said Liz Cheney should go to jail and Adam Schiff should go to prison, he declared Barack Obama of treason. What legal standard are you applying to distinguish what they say and what the president says?

BLANCHE: There can come a point when a criticism becomes a threat and when a threat becomes something criminal.

Holy shit, Blanche really is the tiny mobster from the Bugs Bunny cartoons. Look at him. All he needs is the clownishly oversized hat.

Muggsy Blanche is so fucktacularly terrible at being an enforcer. There’s nothing whatsoever that’s intimidating about him. And he can only dance around the reporter’s question and avoid answering it, because as much as Donny wishes it were true, criticism of Dear Leader is not yet a hate crime in the US.

Never bring a Muggsy to a Constitution fight. He’s out of his depth. Just listen to Jamie Raskin serve him up a big slice of Fuck You Pie.

“The government cannot intimidate people because they exercise their First Amendment rights in a way that government officials don’t like. That’s ridiculous. Somebody should tell Todd Blanche and his team to get a Supreme Court decision called Steffel v. Thompson, which says it’s legally actionable to bring an injunction action against the government if the government is trying to scare you out of exercising your First Amendment rights and your Constitutional rights.

In our case, it’s not just that these members were exercising their Constitutional rights; they were exercising their constitutional duties. We have a duty, as the Article I preeminent branch of government, to conduct oversight operations of the entire government, as well as the economy and other things happening in society.”

Jaime, stop it. He’s already dead.

Here’s the thing that Donny and his few remaining loyalists haven’t yet figured out: nobody is afraid of him any more. He’s the lamest of ducks. The other day, when he started whining about the election results, it was Megyn Kelly — Little Miss Fear of a Black Santa herself — who told Donny to zip it.

Quack fucking quack, Dear Leader. Enjoy your ever-increasing irrelevance.

I’m actually referring to your 30,000 stock trades (more than all Members of Congress combined), your Qatari-gifted luxury jet, your crypto scams, your Truth Social pay to play scheme, your billionaire-funded ballroom, your insurrectionist slush fund, and your pardons for big donors—just to name a few.

Will the Seditious Six ever be prosecuted? What they did was a great violation to our Country and its Constitution! President DONALD J. TRUMP

The Seditious Six? Donny is still whining about the six Congresspeople who put out that video reminding U.S. service members they have a duty to refuse illegal orders? That’s one of many bugs that are up Donny ass on this particular morning?

I have asked Vice President Vance to focus his complete and total attention on the Massive Corruption and Crime taking place in Democrat run Cities and States throughout the U.S. The Blue States, such as Minnesota, California, Illinois, and many more, are all poorly run, corrupt disasters.

Wait, seriously? Couchfuck McGee is now Donny’s corruption czar?

I’m loving this idea. I would pay good money to watch Couchfuck show up at the Minnesota State Capitol and go ‘so, how long have you been corrupt? HA HA, THAT’S GREAT.’

Here we go again! With the perceived loss by the Republicans in the Midterms - I WAS NOT ON THE BALLOT- the INVASION of our Country is taking place again. Huge CARAVANS are forming and beginning their illegal march through Mexico. Many of the people in these Caravans are those that various countries don’t want - “Send them to America,” they say - But they will not be accepted! MEXICO MUST STOP THEM, NOW, and if they do not do so, the Tariffs on Mexico will be IMMEDIATELY DOUBLED. MEXICO, THE GOVERNOR OF TEXAS, THE VERY LIBERAL NEW GOVERNOR OF TEXAS, OUR GREAT BORDER PATROL, & ICE, HAVE BEEN SO INFORMED. There will be no leniency! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP

Holy shit, he’s off his rocker. This is what happens when you live in a fact-free bubble and get all your information from Nosferatu McGoebbels and the Diaper Nurse.

What ‘perceived’ loss in the midterms? What is Donny yammering about? There was nothing ‘perceived’ about the ass-whupping that Donny’s party got. And ? Really? No, Donny, no. You’re supposed to fearmonger about imaginary caravans the election, after.

Dear Leader is bugfuck nuts, and he’s just getting worse. All this batshittery is just from the of the investigations that won’t ramp up until next year. What’s going to happen then? He’s going to completely lose his fucking mind, and god knows what he’s dumbfuckery he’s going to get up to. He’ll probably try to nuke the Capitol building.

This shit is unsustainable.

25th Amendment, let’s go. I’ll take my chances with the couch fucker.

In this election, Americans called on us to unrig an economy rigged against working people & fueled by political corruption.

To deliver, we need new leadership. This isn’t about any one person – it’s about answering that call.

That’s why I’m running for Senate Majority Leader.

We need this. It’s time for the Democratic leadership to be younger and more progressive.

Yes, I know. Senator Van Hollen is 67 years old. That’s still younger than Chuck Schumer, who’s 75.

And he’s definitely more progressive.

Well, it’s Friday — and we made it through another week in one piece. Let’s reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia and get out of here.

A friend texted this photo to me last night. I’d never seen it before. It’s Ms Spouse and her bestie Kathy down at our lake on November 12, 2022.

Okay, that’s put me in the mood for more Kathy and Claudia pics, so here you go.

Have a great Friday, everyone.

items.title: Republicans hate our veterans — and no one hates them more than Preznit Fuckwit
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Yesterday was Veterans Day, and we heard a lot of pungent mouth-farting from the Usual Republican Suspects about how much they and our nation’s veterans.

There they were, tweeting out the same old boilerplate platitudes about and .

It’s all bullshit. The GOP our veterans.

As always, watch what they do, not what they say.

Veterans are useful props whenever some fuckface wingnut needs to burnish their patriot cred, but when it comes time to supporting our veterans — say, by helping them when they’re in need — it’s a completely different story.

Need proof? Let’s go to the video tape, from July 29, 2022:

Here we have a bunch of Republican Senators fist-bumping. Why? Because they just blocked a billthat would have expanded healthcare coverage for military veterans exposed to toxic burn pits during their service.

Who the fuck that? Put down your fists, and at least have the decency to slink away in silence, embarrassed over your ghoulish treachery.

Awesome job, you evil soulless hypocrites — because nothing says ‘we support our heroes’ so much as ‘just fucking die.’

Now let’s fast forward to April 2025, when the Space Nazi’s merry band of unfuckable DOGE incels showed up at the Department of Veterans Affairs and said, ‘good news, everyone — you’re all fired.’ They then took a wrecking ball to the place.

Listen up, shitwits: you send a person into a war zone and tell them to fight for their country, and when they come back injured and permanently disabled, you fucking well take care of them — forever.

It’s basic human decency.

The freedoms we enjoy as Americans came at a cost. Generations answered the call to serve, putting their lives on the line to defend our country and way of life. This Veterans Day, join me in honoring and thanking those who served. We owe them a debt we can never repay.

Steve, with all due respect, fuck off.

You voted against the VA Employee Fairness Act, the Veteran Service Recognition Act, the PACT Act (twice), the Equal Access to Contraception for Veterans Act, and the Ensuring Veterans Smooth Transition Act.

For a guy who claims to honor those who made sacrifices, you have a fucked-up way of showing it.

“Today we salute the brave men and women who wore our nation’s uniform and defended the homeland. Their sacrifice deserves our gratitude, our respect, and our unwavering support. Never forget those who fought for our freedom. God bless our veterans and the United States of America!”

Sit down and shut up, you vapid bobblehead.

In your first term in Congress, you made 15 anti-veteran votes. Last year, you voted to cut funding for the 49,000 veterans in your district by supporting a bill that guts their health care.

How delicious is it that this complete waste of space was just denied reelection by an actual veteran, the retired Rear Admiral Eileen Laubacher?

, Handy. Enjoy fading back into well-deserved obscurity.

“God bless our veterans from Ohio and across the country for their service and sacrifice this Veterans Day.”

By the way, Jimmy Jords can barely be bothered to commemorate the day. He just shits out the same bare minimum every year. Here’s his post from 2025.

“Happy Veterans Day! God Bless all who served. American heroes!”

Shove it, Jimmy. you voted against the PACT Act, the Food Security for All Veterans Act, the Veteran Service Recognition Act and the VA Employee Fairness Act.

Don’t even get me started on five-time draft-dodging diaperload.

I’d love to show you the heartfelt Veterans Day message that Donny posted to his crappy app, but I couldn’t find one. Nothing. Not even a concept of a sketch of one.He couldn’t even be bothered to pretend to give a shit.

Yesterday, Preznit Fuckwit traveled to Arlington National Cemetery and laid a wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier Who Didn’t Have A Rich Father To Get Him Out Of War By Paying A Quack Doctor To Gin Up A Bullshit Note About Imaginary Bone Spurs.

“Soon we’re going to dedicate a magnificent triumphant arch to our veterans.”

Oh, so now we’re supposed to pretend Lord Shitticus is putting up his ginormous arch for ? Oh, please. The fucking abomination is going to plunge the gravesites at Arlington National Cemetery into permanent shadow.

Before we move on, it must be noted that what remains of Dear Leader’s pudding-brain has become a neurological superfund toxic cleanup site.

“Green Beret Ryan Hendrickson was leading his team through a— Taliban-held village in Afghanistan at— 3 in the morning when he was— stepped on by— enemy? I mean, he was the enemy, the enemy was all over. He made the mistake. A mistake that— people understood when they were in the battles, jungles.”

Holy shit. What the fuck was that?

Donny completely loses the thread of what he’s reading off the teleprompter, and just starts winging it. Afghanistan doesn’t have any jungles (I checked with the plagiarism robot, just to make sure), but there are jungles in every war movie Donny’s ever seen on TV, so there you go. He can no longer tell fact from the dim, flickering images playing inside his fat, waterlogged head.

What an utter fucking embarrassment.

Let’s take a look at Donny’s own long history of quote-unquote , because — spoiler alert — .

We can start with that lovely incident in 2024 when private citizen (and convicted felon) Donny trespassed his way into Arlington National Cemetery to do a disgraceful thumb’s-up campaign photo-op while trampling over the graves of fallen heroes — and grinning like an asshole the whole time.

Let’s also not forget that in November 2018, as world leaders gathered at a cemetery in France to honor the memory of US soldiers killed while fighting in World War One, Donny blew the whole thing off — because it was drizzling lightly, and he didn’t want that weird tangle of piss-colored bullshit on top of his head to get wet. Instead, he spent the day rage-tweeting from his hotel room. Good times, bro, good times.

What kind of overgrown grievance-toddler gets mad at a fucking boat?

Now I want to repost something I wrote on September 24, 2023 — because of all the shitty episodes regarding Little Donny Fuckface’s callous treatment of our veterans, this one just might be the rock-bottom worst:

At his welcome ceremony at Joint Base Myer–Henderson Hall, across the Potomac River from the capital, Milley gained an early, and disturbing, insight into Trump’s attitude toward soldiers. Milley had chosen a severely wounded Army captain, Luis Avila, to sing “God Bless America.” Avila, who had completed five combat tours, had lost a leg in an IED attack in Afghanistan and had suffered two heart attacks, two strokes, and brain damage as a result of his injuries. To Milley, and to four-star generals across the Army, Avila and his wife, Claudia, represented the heroism, sacrifice, and dignity of wounded soldiers.

It had rained that day, and the ground was soft; at one point Avila’s wheelchair threatened to topple over. Milley’s wife, Holly­anne, ran to help Avila, as did Vice President Mike Pence. After Avila’s performance, Trump walked over to congratulate him, but then said to Milley, within earshot of several witnesses, “Why do you bring people like that here? No one wants to see that, the wounded.”Never let Avila appear in public again, Trump told Milley. (Recently, Milley invited Avila to sing at his retirement ceremony.)

what a cold-hearted dick.

“why do you bring people like that here? no one wants to see that, the wounded.”

imagine you’re a severely wounded soldier. after five combat tours, sacrificing yourself for your country — you find yourself in a military hospital, minus one leg, your life permanently altered. you live though months of hell — bedridden, undergoing multiple operations and grueling physical therapy — and when finally you’re discharged, you’re confined to a wheelchair for the rest of your life.

and what does the President of the United States — your Commander in Chief — say about you?

“no one wants to see that, the wounded.”

fuck you, Donald Trump. you piece of shit.

Donny, Handy Oakley, Scalise, the whole worthless lot of them — the next time any of these grandstanding performative peacocks starts going on and on about how much they love the shit out of our veterans, remember: watch what they do, not what they say.

But oh you lucky duckies, I saved the most egregious behavior for last.

“Happy Veterans Day — to our best Americans. The Hegseth’s are honored to celebrate our veterans this morning at Arlington with @POTUS, @VP & @SecVetAffairs. Thank God for our warriors, past and present.”

Oh, the really? The Hegseths (no apostrophe, brainiac) are ‘honored to celebrate our veterans’?

These fuckfaces start laughing it up, in front one of our nation’s most solemn monuments — to the point where the guard on duty literally SCREAMS at them that ‘ALL VISITORS WILL MAINTAIN AN ATMOSPHERE OF SILENCE AND PAY RESPECT AT ALL TIMES!”

That’s right, they take this shit seriously at the Tomb. They don’t care if you’re the piss-drunk Secretary of Whatever You’re Calling Yourself This Week. You will keep your fucking mouth shut at all times. This isn’t some open mike. Zip it and keep it zipped.

Go laugh it up in front of the Epstein Dance Hall™, if you must.

Oh my god, it’s every bit as fucktacularly bad as we suspected it would be.

Accountability cannot come soon enough.

We really need a little Daily Claudia right about now, don’t we?

Here’s a triptych from the Newburgh NY restaurant Blu Pointe on September 18, 2025.

Have a great Thursday, everyone.

items.title: House Republicans reveal their 2027 plan: to be unserious, obstructionist shitwits
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Last week’s midterm elections should have been the perfect teachable moment for Republicans. Had they bothered to listen to what We the People were saying, they would have very clearly heard, ‘we’re tired of this shit. Clean up your fucking act, or get used to permanent irrelevance.’

But, of course, Republicans don’t know how to listen — . They proved it yesterday by choosing as their House Leader the huge, steaming pantload, Jim Jordan.

What even is a Jim Jordan? We’ve all seen him strutting around like some fucked-up barnyard banty rooster, shouty, half-dressed, pointing his finger while he excitedly squawks about who the fuck even knows or cares.

Shirt-Sleeve Jimmy has no interest in . He has no interest in reaching across the aisle, and He’s just a weapon. He’s a blunt instrument. He’s a heat-seeking moron.

I swear, Republicans just keep getting worse. Three years ago, the House GOP rejected Jimmy’s attempt to replace Feckless Kevin McCarthy as Speaker of the House. Back then, they wanted no part of Jordan’s unserious clown act. Now, they’re embracing him with open arms.

And then, as if naming the shouty, half-dressed degenerate wrestling coach to be their Leader weren’t already enough, House Republicans then doubled down on the dumbfuckery, sending Tom Emmer to the podium to make infantile, impotent threats.

“To our colleagues on the left, enjoy this honeymoon phase because, come January 3, 2027, you will regret ever putting your name on a ballot… This Republican leadership team will expose the Democrats’ lies and show the American people their true colors as the radical communists that they are.”

Bro, what the fuck are you gibbering about? That’s now how this works. That’s not how any of this works.

Homie, your party’s in the minority. You hold no power. What ‘lies’ do you imagine you’re going to expose? And what’s all this bullshit about Democrats being ?

You stupid fuck, the midterms were a rejection of all the dumb shit you’ve been pulling, and this is your answer? To promise to dole out more of it?

Do House Republicans have some sort of political death wish? What kind of party watches themselves lose (as of this counting) 43 seats and goes, ‘oh yeah, we’re totally crushing it. Let’s do more of the same.’

Dude, read the room. Voters are sick of idiotic red-baiting, and moronic culture wars. They want someone who’ll fix all the shit you broke. That’s why so many of your former colleagues are now out of jobs. You want to join them? Just keep on doing what you’re doing.

Now let’s move on to asshole, Piss-Drunk Pete Kegstand.

Pete weaseled out of getting impeached yesterday, but not before holding some yappy little vanity press conference during which he preened, defiantly flapping his gin-soaked gums in defense of his own lawless self.

“Was die Artikel selbst betrifft: Iran, die Kartelle, Maduro, Jemen. Jede einzelne Operation war rechtmäßig und wurde vom Führer angeordnet.”

In case you don’t speak German, I should probably provide an English translation.

“As for the articles themselves. Iran, the cartels, Maduro, Yemen. Every one was a lawful operation ordered by the Commander-in-Chief.”

Got that? Piss-Drunk Pete was just following orders. Now, where have we all heard that excuse before?

Continuing to write these daily posts has been for me an essential part of my grieving process. But every now and then, the profound sadness of it all becomes just too overwhelming — and so today, I’m going to cut this post short and give myself a bit of a necessary mental health break.

I still feel adrift and unmoored, and I still miss Claudia so much.

Let me once again take a moment to say thank you to the thousands of people who have posted, commented, private messaged, texted, and phoned to offer support and condolences. I am blessed to be surrounded by an amazing, caring community.

Thank you for hanging in there with me. See you tomorrow.

And with that, let’s have us our Daily Claudia.

Today, I want to repost the very first photo I took of Ms Spouse, forty-six-and-a-half years ago, in the spring of 1980, on MacDougal Street in Manhattan.

And I also want to repost Claudia’s final photo, taken on her birthday last February, four days before her passing.

Sigh. I miss her so much.

That’s it for today, I’m outta here. Again, thanks again for hanging in there with me. I promise you that I am taking my own advice: practicing self-care and doing everything I need to do to keep sane. See you tomorrow.
